1. Extend the channel symmetrically to a size the transform can halve often enough.
2. Build the Laplacian pyramid with the 9-7 filters, J levels.
3. Split each band into K directional subbands with the tree of ladder filter banks.
4. Estimate the noise level of the channel, or take the given one.
5. Shrink each subband with kappa times the noise level times its noise gain.
6. Run the filter banks backward, add the bands back to the predictions, and crop.
